jobs.description:

The individual would also be responsible for the timely submission of various dashboards and reports and follow-up within and outside GTX, by constantly innovating and driving the development, delivery and operations of various aspects of Business Management initiatives.

• To perform other activities (ad-hoc) linked to GTX Business i.e. offsite and event support, as appropriate, assigned from time to time.

• Close liaison with staff from Business Finance, DAAI, GTX Solutions & Advisory, Products, Channels, (Global) network, Business Continuity, DLP and other relevant stakeholders.
• Participate in review of various MIS and operational process to ensure that we meet and exceed the expectations of our internal stakeholders.

• Experienced in working with Microsoft Office applications, especially strong skills in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word and other applications.

Preferred / Beneficial

• Arabic preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Lead / Principal Software Engineer (Agentic Engineering / Research) - IFS Labs
jobs.description:
Job Description
At IFS Labs, we explore what is next for enterprise software and turn emerging technologies into working capabilities that shape future IFS products. Our focus spans applied AI, agentic systems, next-generation application architectures, data services, strategic technology direction, and technology partnerships.

We are looking for a Senior Lead / Principal Software Engineer with strong software engineering and architectural skills, combined with a product mindset and a passion for solving real-world problems through software and AI.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on building software, validating emerging technologies, creating production-grade prototypes, and influencing future product and technology direction across IFS. The emphasis is on delivering working solutions that can move from investigation and prototype into real product capabilities.

We are particularly interested in candidates who embrace modern AI-driven engineering practices and agentic engineering approaches to accelerate research, architecture, software development, testing, and delivery. The successful candidate will be comfortable using AI as a force multiplier—leveraging agentic workflows to automate routine knowledge work, rapidly evaluate technologies, synthesise architectural insights, and significantly shorten the path from idea to working software while maintaining high standards of engineering quality.

Projects typically run for 6–12 months and are delivered individually or in small teams. Work ranges from evaluating emerging technologies and architectural patterns to building capabilities that influence future IFS products, platforms, and technology strategy.

A key part of the role involves creating compelling demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and technical showcases for major IFS events, customer engagements, and strategic initiatives. This includes building innovative solutions, validating ideas with customers and partners, and communicating technical vision to diverse audiences.

As a Senior Lead / Principal Software Engineer in IFS Labs, you will identify, evaluate, and apply emerging technologies to real customer and industry challenges, transforming ideas into working capabilities that influence future IFS products, platforms, and technology strategy.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify, evaluate, and validate emerging technologies, architectural patterns, and industry trends relevant to IFS products and customers.
• Design, build, and deliver prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and production-ready capabilities across software engineering, cloud, data, and AI domains.
• Lead technical investigations and architectural studies, producing clear recommendations, reference implementations, and actionable next steps.
• Drive complex technical initiatives from concept through implementation and product handover, applying agentic engineering and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate delivery.
• Collaborate closely with Product Management, Industry teams, Engineering teams, Sales, Presales, customers, and partners to validate ideas, solve real business problems, and shape future IFS products and technology direction.
• Contribute to technical strategy, architectural direction, and engineering practices across IFS.
• Represent IFS in customer engagements, strategic demonstrations, major events, and partner collaborations.
• Mentor engineers and champion engineering excellence, technical curiosity, and high-quality delivery.

Qualifications
Essential

• Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• 8+ years of professional experience in software engineering and software architecture, demonstrated through successfully delivered products and platforms.
• Deep expertise in one or more programming languages such as Python, Java, C#, Golang, or TypeScript.
• Extensive experience designing, building, deploying, and operating enterprise-grade software, with strong architectural expertise across distributed, cloud-native, API-driven, and event-driven systems.
• Proven track record of taking ideas from concept and prototype through to production-ready solutions that integrate with enterprise applications, business processes, and data platforms.
• Demonstrated proficiency in AI-assisted research and software engineering, using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, and modern AI platforms to accelerate technology evaluation, architectural reasoning, and implementation.
• Exceptional ability to rapidly learn and apply new technologies, combined with strong systems thinking, architectural judgement, and a bias towards experimentation and delivery.
• Strong engineering judgement with a relentless focus on code quality, maintainability, security, operational reliability, and fitness for purpose.
• Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives, influence technical direction, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Ability to connect technology decisions to customer outcomes, business value, and product strategy, combining innovative thinking with pragmatic execution.

Desirable

• Experience with applied AI, agentic systems, LLM-powered applications, or data-intensive platforms.
• Experience applying agentic engineering practices and agentic workflows to accelerate research, architecture, implementation, testing, and documentation.
• Experience with Spec-Driven Development (SDD) or comparable agent-driven engineering methodologies such as BMAD.
• Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure, including CI/CD, containerization, observability, and infrastructure automation.
• Strong full-stack engineering experience across modern backend technologies.
• Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, and domain experts to validate ideas and deliver business value.
• Experience with enterprise or industrial domains such as ERP, Service Management, Asset Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, industrial IoT, robotics, autonomous systems, digital twins, or cyber-physical systems.
• Knowledge of the IFS product portfolio and the industries it serves.

Additional Information
We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

jobs.title: Business Analyst (Consumer Lending)
jobs.description:
Role Summary

We are hiring a Business Analyst who owns outcomes, not tickets. This person will independently carry a defined set of business KPIs across growth, operations, and financial performance — diagnosing why numbers move, designing the interventions that move them, and driving those interventions through Product, Risk, Growth, Operations, Collections, and Finance until they land. You will pull your own data, build your own analysis, form your own point of view, and defend it in front of senior leadership. When a metric underperforms, you are the person expected to have the answer — and the proposal.

Responsibilities

•
Write your own SQL to extract, join, and validate data from lending core, payment, CRM, and behavioural event sources — without waiting in a queue for someone else to pull it.

•
Build and maintain the metric trees behind your KPIs, decomposing headline numbers into the operational drivers that actually move them.

•
Investigate performance anomalies end-to-end: isolate whether a movement is driven by mix, policy, product change, seasonality, upstream funnel, or data quality — and prove which.

•
Design and maintain dashboards and recurring reporting that leadership can act on directly.

•
Convert analysis into concrete, quantified proposals: what to change, expected impact in AED, implementation cost, risk trade-off, and how success will be measured.

•
Size opportunities before they are built and validate them after they ship — including designing champion/challenger A/B tests with downstream risk quality (FPD, DPD) as a primary readout, not just conversion.

•
Drive adopted proposals through to implementation with Product, Risk, Engineering, and Operations. Follow-through is part of the job, not a hand-off.

•
Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership in a decision-ready format.

•
Build and maintain unit economics models for lending products: interest income, fee income, cost of funds, expected credit loss, acquisition cost, servicing and collections cost.

•
Understand and be able to explain how pricing, tenor, limit, approval rate, and repayment behaviour each flow through to product-level profitability.

•
Support pricing, limit strategy, and portfolio mix decisions with quantified scenario and sensitivity analysis.

•
Understand loan accounting mechanics: interest accrual, fee recognition, repayment allocation waterfalls, write-offs, recoveries, restructuring, and overdue treatment.

•
Own reconciliation logic and exception analysis between the lending management system, payment providers, and finance ledgers — identify root causes of mismatch and drive them to zero.

•
Partner with Finance to ensure business reporting and financial reporting reconcile, and that revenue is recognised and collected accurately.

•
Map end-to-end lending processes — acquisition, underwriting, disbursement, servicing, collections — and identify where cost, time, or leakage accumulates.

•
Quantify the business case for automation and process redesign, then work with the relevant teams to deliver it.

Requirements

•
4+ years of hands-on experience in consumer lending or consumer credit — at a bank, finance company, digital lender, BNPL provider, or internet-finance platform. Direct lending domain experience is a hard requirement; adjacent fintech experience without credit exposure will not substitute.

•
Strong, independent SQL capability. You extract and validate your own data as a matter of routine.

•
Demonstrated understanding of consumer lending operational flows — application, underwriting and decisioning, limit assignment, disbursement, billing, repayment, delinquency and collections.

•
Working command of lending product P&L structure — you can explain how a loan makes or loses money and what breaks it.

•
Practical experience with accounting treatment of loans and with payment reconciliation — you have investigated real mismatches between systems and resolved them.

•
Track record of proposals you originated that were implemented and produced measurable business results. Be prepared to walk through two of them in detail, including the numbers.

•
Exceptional structured thinking. You can decompose an ambiguous business question into a defensible analytical approach and communicate the logic clearly.

•
Strong written and verbal communication in English, including the ability to present to executive audiences and to work productively with Risk, Finance, Engineering, and Operations counterparts.

•
Proven ability to run multiple workstreams concurrently without dropping commitments.

jobs.summary: We are looking for a Principal Applied Scientist to drive pioneering research and development in AI, focusing on advanced algorithms and model optimisation. Lead the design and integration of innovative AI solutions across multiple modalities. Ideal for experienced professionals with a strong background in AI research and development.
jobs.description:
Overview:


Abu Dhabi

Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception42 functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception42 is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inceptionai.ai

Overview

You will play a crucial part in pioneering research and development across various facets of AI, including but not limited to computer vision, natural language processing, and audio signal processing. Your work will involve the creation and optimization of cutting-edge AI algorithms and deep learning models, contributing to advancements in areas such as semantic understanding, multidimensional data interpretation, and human-machine interactions. Furthermore, your innovative efforts will be applied to a spectrum of practical use cases, serving pivotal industries such as finance, oil and gas, environmental science, and healthcare, thereby driving forward the frontier of impactful AI solutions in real-world scenarios.

Responsibilities:


What You’ll Own

o Engage in the design, analysis and optimization of foundational and applied research to power the state-of-the-art AI algorithms and model capabilities. This will involve staying well-informed of emerging trends, understanding and manipulating complex datasets, and conceptualizing models that are both innovative and applicable to real-world scenarios.

o Work on comprehensive solutions that integrate various modalities, including text, audio, and visual data, enhancing the AI's ability to understand and interpret human interaction in a more nuanced manner.

o Collaborate with researchers and engineers across teams for the design, development, and continual improvement of AI algorithms, ensuring the implementations of such algorithms are optimized for efficiency, reliability, and scalability.

o Work alongside product development teams to integrate new algorithms and models into broader product offerings, and conduct proofs of concept (POC) as per client needs, ensuring that these innovations translate into tangible benefits for users and stakeholders.

o Propose scenarios where AI techniques could improve the efficiency of the customer’s business.

o Provide pre-sales and post-sales technical support to the business development team.

Skills and attributes for success

The criteria for your success would include cost savings achieved, number of use cases investigated & datasets mined, number of innovations/POCs deployed, number of existing processes optimized, and customer NPS.

Qualifications:


What We’re Looking For

o M.Sc. or Ph.D. degree in computer science, engineering, or AI-related field. Specialization in Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing or Speech and Audio are highly desirable.

o Minimum 10 years of experience in developing AI algorithms for various modalities.

o Track record of conducting high-level research, preferably evidenced by publications in peer-reviewed journals or a history of product-driven research and development.

Ideally, you’ll also need

o A highly curious and inquisitive approach to problem-solving

o In-depth knowledge of the latest developments in AI and machine learning

o Excellent communication skills

Why Inception42

Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives.

If you want to work close to both advanced AI capability and real-world execution, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Role for UAE nationals only

Join our Field Engineering team and gain hands-on experience supporting the technical infrastructure that powers Amazon Web Services. You'll work alongside experienced engineers to troubleshoot complex systems, contribute to data center optimization projects, and develop expertise in hyper-scale facility operations while learning how cutting-edge technologies keep our data centers running efficiently.

As an intern you will work with leading-edge technologies and equipment and learn how hyper-scale data centers are able to operate efficiently and with minimal downtime. You will work with tenured Field Engineers (FEs), allowing you to learn and experience the day-to-day activities in a fast-paced and high-tech industry. You will support with deep dives into operational events and may also be given your own projects to run, exposing you to internal systems and operational processes.

Key job responsibilities

• Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.

• Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.

• Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, and increase efficiency.

• Interface with internal data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.

• Work on concurrent projects.

• Support new construction projects during design, build, commissioning, and handover.

A day in the life

As a Field Engineering Intern, you'll immerse yourself in the dynamic environment of Amazon data centers, where you'll collaborate with seasoned Field Engineers on real operational challenges. Your day might include investigating equipment failures and documenting root cause analyses, reviewing complex operating procedures with operations teams, or supporting the design and implementation of data center upgrades that enhance capacity and efficiency. You'll participate in concurrent projects ranging from new construction commissioning to facility optimization initiatives, gaining exposure to internal systems and operational processes. Working across multiple technical domains—from electrical and mechanical systems to environmental considerations—you'll develop a comprehensive understanding of how we maintain reliability and performance at scale.

About the team

We are the Field Engineering team, serving as the technical backbone for AWS Data Center Operations across multiple regions. Our mission is to provide electrical and mechanical expertise throughout the complete lifecycle of our data centers—from initial design through ongoing optimization and maintenance. We collaborate closely with design engineering, server hardware, environmental health and safety, and other partner teams to establish standards that ensure consistency and reliability in the services we deliver. Our team is energized by solving complex technical challenges and supporting our colleagues with the specialized knowledge needed to keep our infrastructure operating at peak performance. Joining us means becoming part of a group committed to continuous improvement and technical excellence.

Basic qualifications
- UAE national with family book

- Fluent written and verbal communication in English and Arabic

- Currently enrolled in a BE/BSc in Electrical / Mechanical/ Design Engineering/ Building Services or similar technical focus graduating in 2027

- Right to work in the United Arab Emirates

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with problem-solving methodologies and analytical approaches to technical challenges

- Demonstrated ability to manage attention to detail and work with data-driven processes

- Experience building collaborative relationships with diverse stakeholders and teams

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with a commitment to maintaining high quality standards in documentation and reporting

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: SOC Analyst
jobs.description:
The SOC Analyst (L1/L2) is responsible for continuous monitoring, detection, analysis, and response to cybersecurity threats across enterprise environments. The role supports 24x7 SOC operations, performing real‑time security event monitoring, incident triage, investigation, escalation, and remediation in accordance with established runbooks, SLAs, and client requirements.

Key Responsibilities

•
Monitor and analyze security alerts from SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and other security tools to identify potential threats.

•
Perform timely triage, validation, and investigation of alerts in accordance with SLA and prioritization matrix (P1–P4).

•
Execute approved containment, response, and remediation actions using defined SOC runbooks.

•
Manage incidents through the full case lifecycle, ensuring accurate documentation, status updates, and closure in the case management system.

•
Follow standard case handling processes, including case stage/status flow and QA validation requirements.

•
Monitor SOC communication channels (e.g., mailbox, SOAR) and ensure timely response to inquiries, escalations, and stakeholder coordination.

•
Escalate high-severity or complex incidents in line with SLAs, including immediate notification for potential P1/P2 cases.

•
Ensure SLA compliance and resolution, including coordination with internal and external stakeholders.

•
Perform shift-based operations, including effective handover of active and critical cases with complete context.

•
Identify and report operational issues, anomalies, or delays within the same shift to relevant leads.

•
Support continuous improvement by supporting in identifying gaps in detection, logging, automation, and case handling processes.

Technical Skills

•
Strong understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, including threat types, attack vectors, the CIA triad, and awareness of frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK for threat identification.

•
Working knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux/Unix) and networking concepts (TCP/IP, OSI model, DNS, HTTP/S).

•
Experience or familiarity with SIEM/SOAR platforms, endpoint protection, firewalls, and security monitoring tools.

•
Ability to analyze logs, network traffic, and endpoint telemetry to identify malicious activity.

•
Exposure to cloud security concepts (Azure, AWS, or GCP) is an advantage.

•
Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework for threat identification is an advantage.

•
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related field.

•
1–3 years of experience in Security Operations, IT security, or a related role.

•
Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts, threats, and attack methodologies.

•
Hands-on exposure or academic experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, or security monitoring tools is an advantage.

•
Familiarity with incident handling, alert triage, and case management processes.

•
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

•
Good written and verbal communication skills for documentation and handover reporting.

•
Relevant certifications – e.g., Security+, SC-200, CEH (Associate level) – are an advantage but not mandatory.

About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.

jobs.description:

• Develop, implement, and continuously enhance the Cyber Security Risk Governance framework, policies, and standards in line with e& business strategy, regulatory obligations, and leading international practices (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, etc.).

Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Overview

Set the direction for security and information security governance across Inception42’s enterprise platforms, cloud services, and product environments. You will own security strategy, risk oversight, control assurance, and security operations, translating business priorities and customer commitments into effective protection. This director role combines executive accountability with technical judgment: building a capable security function, directing investment, and ensuring that security controls work in production.

Responsibilities:


Define and deliver the security strategy, operating model, and prioritised roadmap. Align investment, staffing, tooling, and managed services with material risks, business priorities, and delivery needs.

• Own the information security governance framework, including policies, standards, control ownership, exceptions, and assurance. Maintain practical alignment with ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS, and applicable obligations.

• Direct security risk management across enterprise and product environments. Maintain a clear risk register, agree treatment with accountable owners, escalate residual exposure, and ensure risk acceptance follows defined decision authority.

• Provide executive reporting on security posture, material risks, control effectiveness, incident trends, remediation, and investment trade-offs. Make decisions and unresolved exposures clear and actionable.

• Lead the security team, setting responsibilities, performance expectations, development plans, and succession priorities. Build technical capability and accountability across internal teams and managed providers.

• Own security operations outcomes across monitoring, detection engineering, alert triage, investigation, and response. Set coverage and service expectations and challenge the effectiveness of SIEM, EDR, and detection controls.

• Direct the response to major security incidents, coordinating technical containment, investigation, recovery, stakeholder communication, and post-incident review. Ensure corrective actions are completed and validated.

• Govern vulnerability and exposure management, with risk-based prioritisation, accountable remediation owners, agreed service levels, exception handling, and escalation of overdue material risks.

• Own the security compliance and assurance programme, including applicable UAE requirements, ISO 27001 certification activities, customer security commitments, and internal and external audits through verified closure.

• Set security architecture and design review standards for cloud workloads, enterprise systems, and product initiatives. Partner with Engineering on identity, access, workload protection, secure delivery, and operational controls.

• Direct customer security assurance, due diligence, questionnaires, and evidence responses, ensuring commitments accurately reflect implemented controls and agreed remediation plans.

• Govern business continuity and disaster recovery with service owners, aligning recovery objectives, dependencies, failover arrangements, and exercises with business needs. Track test findings to closure.

• Manage security budgets, vendor performance, tooling value, and managed service outcomes. Use evidence of risk reduction and control effectiveness to guide procurement and renewal decisions.

• Build security awareness and shared accountability across the organisation. Embed security reviews and practical control ownership into platform, application, and product change.

Qualifications:


What We’re Looking For

• Experience leading an information security function or a substantial security domain, with accountability for strategy, delivery, line management, and measurable improvements in security posture.

• Strong governance, risk, and compliance expertise, including ownership of policy and control frameworks aligned to ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or CIS, and delivery of audit or certification programmes.

• Proven ability to translate business priorities and risk exposure into a funded security roadmap, clear operating responsibilities, and effective internal and vendor delivery.

• Deep practical security operations experience, including SIEM and detection tuning, alert triage, EDR, major incident leadership, and the ability to challenge technical findings and recovery decisions.

• Experience governing vulnerability management, risk-based prioritisation, remediation commitments, control exceptions, and escalation across platform and application owners.

• Cloud security capability across Azure or AWS, including posture management, identity and access controls, workload protection, and secure architecture patterns.

• Credible executive and technical communication, with the judgment to explain trade-offs, escalate material exposure, and maintain security standards under delivery pressure.

• Relevant professional certification such as CISSP, CISM, or a recognised cloud or security architecture certification.

Nice to Have

• Experience applying UAE security requirements and national frameworks in public-sector or regulated customer environments.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Purview, Entra ID, identity governance, and privileged access management.

• Experience with DevSecOps, secure SDLC, pipeline and container security, penetration testing, or threat modelling.

• Experience governing AI systems and data, including model, agent, and data protection risks, and leading continuity and recovery exercises.

Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives.

If you want to work close to both advanced AI capability and real-world execution, we’d like to hear from you.

What We Look For

If you are a performance-driven, inquisitive mind with the agility to adapt to ambiguity, you will fit right in. You should be eager to explore opportunities to build meaningful collaborations with stakeholders and aspire to create unique customer-centric solutions. • Provide security review and design authority for new systems, cloud workloads and acquisitions, with particular attention to how identity and access are handled.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP Consultant to lead and support the design, implementation, and optimisation of SAP solutions. The successful candidate will bring deep functional and/or technical expertise across SAP modules relevant to operations, including logistics, asset management, procurement, finance, and human resources. You will work closely with client stakeholders, programme managers, and technical teams to deliver mission-critical SAP solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end SAP implementation and support projects
• Gather and translate complex business requirements into SAP functional and technical specifications
• Configure, test, and deploy SAP modules in line with SAP standards and regulatory frameworks
• Provide subject matter expertise across relevant SAP modules (listed below)
• Liaise with stakeholders to manage expectations and drive solution adoption
• Conduct workshops, training sessions, and user acceptance testing (UAT)
• Ensure data integrity, security compliance, and audit readiness across all SAP environments
• Contribute to solution architecture design and continuous improvement initiatives
• Manage and mentor junior consultants and client-side SAP teams

SAP Modules – Required Knowledge

Finance & Controlling

• SAP FI (Financial Accounting) – General ledger, accounts payable/receivable, asset accounting for assets
• SAP CO (Controlling) – Cost centre accounting, internal orders, project cost tracking
• SAP FM (Funds Management) – Budget management, commitment accounting aligned to regulatory spending controls
• SAP GM (Grants Management) – Funding from agencies
• SAP PSM (Public Sector Management) –Budget execution and compliance

Logistics & Supply Chain

• SAP MM (Materials Management) – Procurement, inventory management, catalogue management
• SAP WM / EWM (Warehouse / Extended Warehouse Management) – Depot management, spare parts logistics
• SAP IM (Inventory Management) – Stock control including serialised and batch-managed items
• SAP SD (Sales & Distribution) – Inter-agency sales, cross-charging, equipment loans and returns
• SAP TM (Transportation Management) – Movement of equipment, vehicles, and materiel
• SAP GTS (Global Trade Services) – Export controls, dual-use goods compliance, ITAR/EAR adherence

Plant Maintenance & Asset Management

• SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) – Equipment maintenance scheduling, corrective and preventive maintenance
• SAP EAM (Enterprise Asset Management) – Full lifecycle management of assets
• SAP CS (Customer Service) – Equipment repair and return management

Project & Programme Management

• SAP PS (Project System) – Management of acquisition projects, capital programmes, and R&D
• SAP PPM (Portfolio & Project Management) – Programme, resource planning, and milestone tracking

Human Resources & Workforce

• SAP HCM (Human Capital Management) – personnel records, payroll, absence management
• SAP SuccessFactors – Talent acquisition, performance management, and workforce planning

Quality & Compliance

• SAP QM (Quality Management) – Inspection lots, quality control, supplier qualification
• SAP GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) – Access control, audit management, segregation of duties, regulatory compliance

Analytics & Reporting

• SAP BW/4HANA – operational reporting and data warehousing
• SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) – Dashboards, KPIs, and mission readiness reporting

Technology & Integration

• SAP S/4HANA – Core ERP platform (on-premise or private cloud for classified environments)
• SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) – Integration, automation, and app development
• SAP PI/PO / Integration Suite – Middleware integration
• SAP Fiori – Role-based UX for field and operational users

Essential Requirements

• Proven experience (5+ years) delivering SAP solutions in highly regulated environments
• Deep functional expertise in at least three of the above SAP modules
• Understanding of procurement frameworks
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills at senior/executive level
• SAP certification in one or more relevant modules (desirable)

Desirable Requirements

• Knowledge of ITIL, PRINCE2, or Agile delivery methodologies
• Experience with SAP RISE or private cloud deployment
• Background in logistics, engineering, or programme management

• Opportunity to work on high-impact programmes
• Professional development and SAP certification support
• [Pension / benefits / flexible working as applicable]

jobs.description:
Do you want to directly influence the future of some of the most successful products in cloud computing? Come join Amazon Web Services Finance! Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of enterprise, government and start-up business and organizations in over 190 countries around the world. Launched in 2006, Amazon Web Services officially began offering developer customers access to web services – now widely known as cloud computing – based on Amazon’s own back-end technology platform.

On the AWS Finance team you will be surrounded by people that are exceptionally talented, bright, and driven, and believe that world class support is critical to customer success. To support this quickly growing business, you must be highly analytical and possess a strong passion for analytics and accountability, setting high standards, and razor-sharp accuracy. We take working hard, having fun, and making history seriously and you should too!

We provide end-to-end financial support driving AWS to be the low cost provider in Cloud computing and leader in customer experience. This includes supporting business owners in building, operating and innovating our Cloud datacenters. We support operations, business development, and engineering. You should be passionate about producing financial analysis enabling management to make breakthrough decisions, drive cash flow, and ultimately delight our customers.

We are growing rapidly in existing regions as well as expanding into new regions.

At Amazon, we believe that in-person collaboration is essential to our culture and innovation. While we allow flexibility for personal circumstances, we generally expect employees to work from our offices five days a week. This approach has consistently shown that spontaneous interactions, rapid problem-solving, and the energy of in-person teamwork lead to better results for our customers. In particular, our data shows that teams working together in person are more effective at making complex decisions, onboarding new team members, and fostering the kind of creative collaboration that has driven Amazon's success. The serendipitous hallway conversations and impromptu whiteboarding sessions that happen naturally in an office environment have proven invaluable to our invention process and maintaining our high bar for excellence.

Key job responsibilities

- Serve as a key business partner working directly with regional AWS management and other internal stakeholders to provide financial recommendations

- Report weekly and monthly financial and operating metrics

- Manage the financial planning process. Model, analyze and forecast metrics that drive budgeting, forecasting and business decisions

- Be an integral member in the monthly financial close process and perform ad-hoc projects and analysis as needed

- Analyze business results for key takeaways to achieve business objectives

- Monitor compliance with controls and systems, and developing new processes to support the fast-growing, global AWS business

- Preparing detailed financial models for business segments, drive business initiatives, and identify, implement, and deliver key operational efficiencies

Basic qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in accounting, information systems, finance, or equivalent

- Experience applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses

- Experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis

- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis

- Experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes

- Experience in commercial finance business partnering or FP&A, or experience or equivalent experience in finance roles

Preferred qualifications

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: We're looking for an experienced **Security Engineer** to help design, implement, and operate security across our infrastructure, applications, networks, and isolated computing environments. This is a hands-on technical role covering identity and access management, cryptography, secrets management, endpoint security, secure software delivery, and on-premises infrastructure. You'll work across connected environments, client-site data centres, and air-gapped systems where security, reliability, and operational discipline are essential. What you'll do: * Design and manage identity and access controls, including SSO, MFA, federation, privileged access, and machine identities. * Configure and operate Keycloak or an equivalent self-hosted identity provider. * Manage secrets, certificates, public key infrastructure (PKI), certificate authorities, and cryptographic keys, including secure key ceremonies. * Secure Linux systems, networks, endpoints, and on-premises infrastructure. * Implement security controls for air-gapped environments, including controlled data transfers, offline updates, and network segmentation. * Secure self-hosted source control and CI/CD pipelines, ideally GitLab Self-Managed, including secrets scanning, dependency management, and artifact signing. * Support network security across multiple sites, including firewalls, IPsec tunnels, VPNs, reverse proxies, and access controls. * Operate vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response, and infrastructure hardening processes. * Maintain technical documentation, security configurations, operational runbooks, and audit evidence. What we're looking for: * At least 5 years of hands-on experience in security engineering, infrastructure security, or a closely related technical security role. * Practical experience with identity and access management, ideally Keycloak, including OIDC, SAML, SSO, federation, and MFA. * Experience with PKI, certificate lifecycle management, cryptographic keys, and secrets management platforms such as HashiCorp Vault or OpenBao. * Strong Linux, networking, and infrastructure security fundamentals. * Experience securing on-premises environments, data centres, or isolated/air-gapped networks. * Understanding of network segmentation, VPN/IPsec, firewalls, and secure remote access. * Experience with source control and CI/CD security, preferably GitLab Self-Managed. * Ability to automate security tasks using Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar tools. * Experience with security monitoring, vulnerability remediation, and incident response. * Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to document and explain technical decisions. Nice to have: * Experience operating an offline root CA and personally participating in or leading a formal key ceremony. * Hands-on experience with hardware security modules (HSMs). * Experience with MDM, endpoint detection and response (EDR), and zero-trust security. * Experience in defence, government, financial services, or critical infrastructure. * Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2, or NIST security frameworks. * Experience with on-premises Kubernetes and container security. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex technical security challenges and takes ownership of building and maintaining secure systems. **Employment:** Full-time, permanent **Location and work arrangement:** To be confirmed. Salt is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

The OT Cybersecurity Manager will lead programs spanning OT security strategy, architecture, risk assessment, IT/OT convergence and security implementation across complex industrial and critical infrastructure environments.

• Lead end-to-end OT/ICS cybersecurity consulting engagements, from assessment and strategy through architecture, remediation and implementation.

• Build trusted relationships with CISOs, CIOs, OT leaders, engineering teams, plant management and security stakeholders.

You will design and execute manual and automated tests, turn product requirements into measurable acceptance criteria, and provide clear evidence of product quality throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

• Validate document ingestion and retrieval workflows, including source relevance, reference accuracy, data freshness, and user access permissions.

• Test AI-driven orchestration and tool integrations for correct action execution, confirmation steps, authorization boundaries, retries, and prevention of duplicate or unintended actions.

• Maintain reusable business scenarios, representative test data, and regression suites that cover changes to prompts, configurations, integrations, and application releases.

• Integrate automated smoke and regression tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide timely, actionable feedback.

• Validate financial calculations, reconciliations, reporting, access controls, and audit trails across AI-assisted and conventional workflows.

• Evaluate end-to-end responsiveness, concurrent usage, and application stability under expected and peak workloads.

• Own defect documentation, triage, retesting, and root-cause collaboration, and convert production findings into stronger test coverage.

• Experience testing production web or cloud applications across UI, API, integration, and end-to-end workflows.

• Hands-on experience building or maintaining automated tests with tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, REST Assured, Postman, or comparable frameworks.

• Strong debugging and communication skills, with the judgment to distinguish blocking defects from acceptable residual risk.

• An ownership mindset and the ability to execute across ambiguity while collaborating closely with engineers, product managers, and domain specialists.

Nice to Have

• Experience testing conversational AI, enterprise search, document processing, RAG applications, or AI-driven workflows.

• Exposure to Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service, or Azure Data Factory.

• Experience with performance, security, accessibility, or multi-tenant access-control testing.

The Product Manager acts as the voice of the customer, translating insights into impactful product features, and coordinates with cross-functional teams to ensure timely and effective delivery. Strategic Planning & Execution

• Create and maintain detailed product roadmaps, prioritizing features and enhancements based on business impact and stakeholder input.

• Collaborate with digital division and business stakeholders to manage the product backlog, ensuring clear prioritization and resource allocation.

• Monitor competitive landscape and benchmark ADNOC Distribution’s mobile offerings against industry best practices to maintain market leadership.

• Implement data-driven processes for identifying and resolving operational issues, leveraging customer feedback and analytics.

Ensure all mobile platforms comply with security, privacy, and regulatory standards, proactively addressing risks and vulnerabilities.

• Benchmark operational performance against industry standards, recommending improvements to enhance reliability and user satisfaction.

• Owns end to end mobile led customer journeys impacting loyalty, payments, and service consumption across the enterprise

• Oversee the entire product lifecycle, from ideation through launch and post-release optimization, ensuring seamless transitions between phases.

• Foster a culture of innovation and accountability within the product team, encouraging proactive problem-solving and continuous learning.

• Drive post-launch analysis and optimization, using performance data to inform future enhancements and strategic direction.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Leads cross functional change initiatives across Marketing, CX, Digital, IT, Operations, and Finance to align execution with enterprise priorities.

• Serve as the primary liaison between business units and the mobile app development team, facilitating clear communication and alignment.

• Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with marketing, customer service, and analytics teams to ensure cohesive product delivery.

• Present product updates, performance insights, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

• Gather and synthesize stakeholder feedback to inform product decisions and prioritize enhancements.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners to support product success. Tools & Technologies Management

• Oversee the selection and implementation of CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics) to support mobile app initiatives.

• Utilize analytics and business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to monitor performance and inform decision-making.

• Manage project workflows using platforms such as Jira and Smartsheet, ensuring transparency and accountability.

• Integrate customer experience and voice-of-customer tools (e.g., Medallia, Qualtrics) to capture actionable insights.

• Leverage mobile app monitoring and feedback solutions (e.g., Firebase, AppDynamics, UXCam) to optimize user experience. Performance Measurement & Reporting

• Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) including CSAT, NPS, App Store Ratings, and feature adoption rates.

• Monitor product delivery metrics such as feature release velocity, roadmap adherence, and return on investment (ROI).

• Analyze operational metrics including crash rate, load time, and user retention to identify areas for improvement.

Report on engagement and growth metrics, including Monthly Active Users (MAU) and conversion rates, to inform strategic decisions.

• Collect and evaluate stakeholder satisfaction data to ensure cross-functional alignment and continuous improvement.

Compliance & Risk Management

• Ensure all mobile app initiatives adhere to ADNOC Distribution’s compliance standards and regulatory requirements.

• Proactively identify and mitigate risks related to data privacy, security, and operational continuity.

• Develop and maintain documentation for compliance audits and regulatory reviews.

• Collaborate with legal and IT teams to address emerging compliance challenges.

• Educate team members on compliance best practices and foster a culture of risk awareness.

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

Minimum Qualification

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Business, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.

Minimum Experience & Knowledge & Skills

• Minimum 10 years of experience in product management with significant exposure to large scale mobile platforms, enterprise transformation, and senior leadership engagement.

• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and deliver customer-centric digital solutions.

• Familiarity with agile methodologies and mobile app development frameworks.

• Experience with CRM, analytics, project management, and customer experience tools.

• Demonstrated ability to drive innovation, operational excellence, and strategic alignment.

jobs.title: Mid-Level SAP Integration Consultant
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Senior SAP Integration Consultant to join an exciting enterprise transformation programme in Abu Dhabi, working at the intersection of SAP Integration, AI and next-generation enterprise architecture. This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional SAP integrations and help shape how AI agents securely interact with enterprise SAP systems, including S/4HANA and SuccessFactors. You'll play a key role in designing and delivering secure, scalable integration solutions using SAP BTP, Integration Suite, API Management and OData, while exploring emerging technologies such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic AI. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and manage integrations using SAP Integration Suite (CPI/Cloud Integration) and SAP API Management. Build and expose secure OData services, API proxies and integration flows (iFlows) across SAP and non-SAP applications. Develop custom APIs for SAP S/4HANA, including CDS-based OData services, RFC/BAPI integrations and ABAP-based endpoints. Enable secure connectivity between SAP systems and AI-powered applications and autonomous agents. Explore and implement MCP Gateway / MCP Server capabilities to support AI-agent integration. Design robust API security and governance frameworks, including OAuth2, XSUAA, authentication, authorisation and access controls. Collaborate with AI engineering, platform and business teams to define integration requirements and API contracts. Ensure data security, auditability and compliance across AI-driven integrations, particularly for sensitive HR and financial data. Troubleshoot, monitor and optimise enterprise integration services. Required Skills & Experience 3-5 years of hands-on SAP integration experience, including SAP PI/PO, CPI or SAP Integration Suite. Strong expertise in SAP BTP Integration Suite, Cloud Integration and API Management. Proven experience developing iFlows, API proxies and OData services (v2/v4). Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA integrations, CDS Views, RFC/BAPI and custom API development. Experience integrating SAP SuccessFactors and other enterprise applications. Knowledge of integration adapters and protocols including REST, SOAP, HTTP, IDoc, RFC and SFTP. Strong understanding of SAP BTP security, OAuth2, XSUAA, Destination Service and principal propagation. Experience designing secure APIs for external platforms and third-party applications. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with technical teams and business stakeholders. Highly Desirable Exposure to Agentic AI, Generative AI or AI-driven enterprise applications. Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP), MCP Servers or AI agent tool integration. Experience designing APIs specifically for AI agents or intelligent automation platforms. Knowledge of enterprise API governance, data masking, audit logging and least-privilege access. You'll have the opportunity to work on an innovative programme bringing together SAP enterprise systems and emerging AI technologies, helping define how intelligent agents access, interact with and automate complex business processes. Salt is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

JOB TITLE
Cinema Service Engineer | MAF Entertainment | Cinemas

ROLE SUMMARY
The Cinema Service Engineer will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, repair, and support of digital cinema projection, audio, networking, and presentation systems across VOX Cinemas locations. The role involves troubleshooting technical issues, supporting new cinema deployments, monitoring system performance, coordinating installations, and ensuring optimal cinema presentation standards while maintaining safety, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

ROLE PROFILE

• Install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair digital cinema projection, audio, networking, and automation systems.
• Support the deployment and commissioning of digital cinema systems across new and existing VOX Cinemas locations.
• Conduct installation and wiring of audio racks, speaker cabling, TMS, and network infrastructure.
• Monitor system performance and perform preventive maintenance to minimize equipment downtime.
• Coordinate with internal teams, suppliers, and stakeholders to ensure successful project execution and equipment delivery.
• Maintain technical documentation, installation reports, and calibration records.
• Provide technical support, fault diagnosis, and remote assistance for cinema systems and equipment.
• Ensure compliance with safety standards, security procedures, and company policies during all technical activities.

REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor’s degree, Diploma, or Technical Certification in Electrical Engineering, IT, or a related technical field.
• Minimum 4 years of experience servicing digital cinema systems and equipment.
• Strong technical problem-solving, troubleshooting, and equipment repair skills.
• Good understanding of cinema projection, audio, automation, and control systems.
• Certification course in Barco or Christie (Level I or II) projection system.
• Valid UAE driving license is required.

You will earn trust by showing technical credibility, working through complexity across large organisations, and delivering results that move the business forward.

You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with enterprise customers end-to-end. This means:

- Engaging customers to understand their business drivers for cloud adoption, assess their existing on-premises or multi-cloud landscape, and architect a credible path to AWS

- Building the technical case for AWS: total cost of ownership analyses, migration strategies, and proof-of-value engagements that deliver value.

- Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, migration runbooks, landing zone blueprints, and production-ready reference architectures. You lead by doing, not just advising.

- Helping customers envision and build with generative AI and machine learning — often as the catalyst that makes AWS the platform of choice by demonstrating what's uniquely possible with AWS AI/ML services.

- Partnering closely with Account Managers and Business Development to shape the go-to-market strategy for accounts — you are the technical credibility that converts pipeline into adoption.

- Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights from customers into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

- Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, immersion days, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

- You make the team stronger by mentoring fellow Solutions Architects — sharing what you know and helping others grow.

A day in the life

No two days look the same. You might spend the morning in a technical workshop with a financial services customer exploring whether to lift-and-shift their core banking platform or re-architect on AWS, then pivot to a hands-on proof of concept helping a retail customer build on Amazon Bedrock. In the afternoon you might build a landing zone design for a customer that just signed their Enterprise Agreement, draft a migration playbook for a hospitality company, or join a call with an AWS service team to advocate for a feature that would unblock a key deal. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and the patience required to build trust with the urgency of a team that moves fast.

About the team

AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Basic qualifications
- 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- 10+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

- Experience architecting or deploying Cloud/Virtualization solutions in enterprise customers

- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

Preferred qualifications
- 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience

- Experience working with end user or developer communities

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS

- Experience demonstrating technical breadth in AWS and/or cloud fundamentals

- - Experience designing landing zones, multi-account strategies, and governance frameworks for new adopters

- - Experience working with end-user or developer communities

jobs.title: Lead SOC Engineer (OT Cybersecurity)
locations: MBZ City, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: We are currently hiring a Lead SOC Engineer (OT Cybersecurity) to design and implement advanced threat detection in OT environments. You will engineer detection logic, integrate OT telemetry, and support SOC operations. Ideal candidates bring extensive OT cybersecurity expertise and leadership experience in industrial security.
jobs.description:
Overview:


OT Detection is a senior technical and engineering leader role focused on designing and implementing advanced threat detection capabilities within OT environments. Operating within CPX’s hybrid Security Operations Centers (SOCs), this role emphasizes engineering detection logic, integrating OT telemetry, and enhancing visibility across ICS/SCADA systems. The position requires deep expertise in OT cybersecurity, threat hunting, and SOC operations, with a strong understanding of regional industrial sectors and compliance frameworks.

Responsibilities:


• Detection Engineering : Design, develop, and fine tune OT specific detection use cases, correlation rules, and analytics within SIEM platforms to enhance threat visibility and reduce false positives.

•SOAR Playbook Engineering: Build, maintain, and optimize SOAR playbooks to automate investigation and response workflows for OT and IT security events.

• Alert Development & SOC Enablement: Create, refine, and document SOC alert logic to ensure high fidelity detection and smooth operational handover to analysts.

•Tool Integration: Deploy, configure, and optimize OT security platforms such as Dragos, Claroty, and Nozomi to improve monitoring coverage and asset visibility.

Telemetry Onboarding: Integrate OT data sources—including PLC logs, historian data, network telemetry, and asset inventories—into SIEM/SOAR and broader SOC workflows.

• SOC Collaboration: Partner closely with SOC analysts and IT/OT teams to validate detections, enhance triage processes, and ensure seamless integration of OT monitoring capabilities.

• Compliance Alignment: Ensure all detection and response strategies align with relevant regulatory and industry frameworks, including NESA, SAMA, NIST 800 82, and IEC 62443.

• Incident Support: Lead or support technical investigations involving OT assets, providing deep expertise during incident response activities and post incident reviews.

Skills/Certifications (Technical & Non-Technical : -

• Advanced OT Detection Engineering: Proven ability to design and implement high-fidelity detection logic tailored to OT environments, including ICS/SCADA systems and industrial protocols.

• Deep Protocol Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with OT/ICS protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC, IEC 61850, and their behavioral patterns in threat scenarios.

• SIEM Use Case Development: Extensive experience building and tuning OT-specific use cases and correlation rules in SIEM platforms (e.g., QRadar, Splunk), with a focus on minimizing false positives and enhancing alert fidelity.

• Telemetry Integration: Skilled in onboarding OT telemetry sources (e.g., PLC logs, historian data, network traffic) into SOC workflows for enhanced visibility and detection.

• Scripting & Automation: Proficient in Python and PowerShell for automating detection workflows, parsing OT logs, and building custom alerting mechanisms.

• Cross-Domain Collaboration: Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with SOC analysts, OT engineers, and incident response teams.

• Operational Awareness: Deep understanding of SOC operations, OT threat landscapes, and the unique challenges of securing industrial environments in the Middle East.

Certifications : -

• Cybersecurity: CISSP, CISM, or equivalent.

• OT-Specific: GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Certificate, Dragos, Nozomi.

• Networking: CCNP/CCIE.

• Additional certifications related to SOAR or SIEM solutions would be considered an advantage

Qualifications:


Minimum Work Experience : -

• Minimum of 8–10 years in SOC operations, with significant experience in OT cybersecurity.

• Prior experience in a lead engineering role within a SOC or industrial cybersecurity environment.

Education : -

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field.

• Master’s degree or equivalent recognized cybersecurity certifications preferred

jobs.title: SAP Solutions Analyst
locations: Abu Dhabi, Sowwah Square - Al Sila Tower
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP Consultant to lead and support the design, implementation, and optimisation of SAP solutions. The successful candidate will bring deep functional and/or technical expertise across SAP modules relevant to operations, including logistics, asset management, procurement, finance, and human resources. You will work closely with client stakeholders, programme managers, and technical teams to deliver mission-critical SAP solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end SAP implementation and support projects
• Gather and translate complex business requirements into SAP functional and technical specifications
• Configure, test, and deploy SAP modules in line with SAP standards and regulatory frameworks
• Provide subject matter expertise across relevant SAP modules (listed below)
• Liaise with stakeholders to manage expectations and drive solution adoption
• Conduct workshops, training sessions, and user acceptance testing (UAT)
• Ensure data integrity, security compliance, and audit readiness across all SAP environments
• Contribute to solution architecture design and continuous improvement initiatives
• Manage and mentor junior consultants and client-side SAP teams

SAP Modules – Required Knowledge

Finance & Controlling

• SAP FI (Financial Accounting) – General ledger, accounts payable/receivable, asset accounting for assets
• SAP CO (Controlling) – Cost centre accounting, internal orders, project cost tracking
• SAP FM (Funds Management) – Budget management, commitment accounting aligned to regulatory spending controls
• SAP GM (Grants Management) – Funding from agencies
• SAP PSM (Public Sector Management) –Budget execution and compliance

Logistics & Supply Chain

• SAP MM (Materials Management) – Procurement, inventory management, catalogue management
• SAP WM / EWM (Warehouse / Extended Warehouse Management) – Depot management, spare parts logistics
• SAP IM (Inventory Management) – Stock control including serialised and batch-managed items
• SAP SD (Sales & Distribution) – Inter-agency sales, cross-charging, equipment loans and returns
• SAP TM (Transportation Management) – Movement of equipment, vehicles, and materiel
• SAP GTS (Global Trade Services) – Export controls, dual-use goods compliance, ITAR/EAR adherence

Plant Maintenance & Asset Management

• SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) – Equipment maintenance scheduling, corrective and preventive maintenance
• SAP EAM (Enterprise Asset Management) – Full lifecycle management of assets
• SAP CS (Customer Service) – Equipment repair and return management

Project & Programme Management

• SAP PS (Project System) – Management of acquisition projects, capital programmes, and R&D
• SAP PPM (Portfolio & Project Management) – Programme, resource planning, and milestone tracking

Human Resources & Workforce

• SAP HCM (Human Capital Management) – personnel records, payroll, absence management
• SAP SuccessFactors – Talent acquisition, performance management, and workforce planning

Quality & Compliance

• SAP QM (Quality Management) – Inspection lots, quality control, supplier qualification
• SAP GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) – Access control, audit management, segregation of duties, regulatory compliance

Analytics & Reporting

• SAP BW/4HANA – operational reporting and data warehousing
• SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) – Dashboards, KPIs, and mission readiness reporting

Technology & Integration

• SAP S/4HANA – Core ERP platform (on-premise or private cloud for classified environments)
• SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) – Integration, automation, and app development
• SAP PI/PO / Integration Suite – Middleware integration
• SAP Fiori – Role-based UX for field and operational users

Essential Requirements

• Proven experience (5+ years) delivering SAP solutions in highly regulated environments
• Deep functional expertise in at least three of the above SAP modules
• Understanding of procurement frameworks
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills at senior/executive level
• SAP certification in one or more relevant modules (desirable)

Desirable Requirements

• Knowledge of ITIL, PRINCE2, or Agile delivery methodologies
• Experience with SAP RISE or private cloud deployment
• Background in logistics, engineering, or programme management

What We Offer

• Opportunity to work on high-impact programmes
• Professional development and SAP certification support
• [Pension / benefits / flexible working as applicable]
