jobs.title: CNC Programmer (Composites)
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


ADVANCED CONCEPTS is an entity within EDGE dedicated to the design and deployment of advanced, innovative technologies. ADVANCED CONCEPTS is fast-tracking the development of high-technology autonomous systems, including three Medium Endurance, High Altitude, fixed-wing unmanned aerial systems, a family of precision loitering munitions, a cost- effective family of cruise missiles, and a range of guided artillery munitions.

CNC Programmer requires to independently program and operate CNC mills, lathes and multi-axis machines using Mastercam 2022 and PowerMill Ultimate to manufacture precision components.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Independently program, set up, operate CNC machines (mills, lathes, or multi-axis).

• Interpret complex engineering drawings and convert them into CNC programs using

• CAM PACKAGE - MASTERCAM 2022 and PowerMill Ultimate.

• Select appropriate tooling, fixtures, and machining strategies for precision components.

• Optimize machining parameters to improve efficiency, tool life, and part quality.

• Perform first-piece inspection and troubleshoot machining issues.

• Train and guide junior technicians on machine operation and safety practices.

• Ensure routine maintenance and upkeep of CNC equipment and workstations.

• Support loading and machine setup as necessary

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Diploma or Degree Mechanical Engineering / CNC Machining
• Experience with multi-axis CNC machines, mill-turn centers.
• Familiarity with prototyping or low-volume production workflows.
• Must possess a strong command of the English language and written communication skills.
• Strong initiative to perform cleaning and support activities
• Good troubleshooting, communication, and mentoring abilities.
• Can-do attitude and proactive nature
• Commitment and strong sense of accountability
• Organization and diligence in reporting work activities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Proficient in reading engineering drawings, GD&T,

• Strong understanding of cutting tools, materials, speeds, and feeds.

• Able to independently produce high-precision parts with minimal supervision.

• Skilled in creating, editing, and optimizing CNC programs (G-code, M-code) for multi-axis machining operations.

• Process Optimization – Ability to fine-tune machining parameters to improve cycle time, tool life, and overall efficiency

• Verify dimensions, clearances, and alignments using calipers, micrometers, gauges, and other measuring tools.

• Ensure finished parts meet company quality standards, ISO procedures, and customer requirements.

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

CANDIDATE PRIVACY & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. We believe every individual deserves to be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, and our employment decisions reflect that. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

Please note that EDGE does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes in the absence of a formally executed agreement in place will be deemed the property of EDGE, and no placement fees or compensation will be payable in respect of such submissions.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer - AI
jobs.description:
Job Description
Role Overview

As a DevOps Engineer - AI Platform & MLOps, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and operational excellence practices that support AI and machine learning solutions. You will work closely with AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Solution Architects, and Platform Engineers to ensure AI services are secure, scalable, reliable, and production-ready.

Key Responsibilities

AI Platform Engineering

• Design, build, and maintain cloud-native infrastructure supporting AI workloads.
• Manage AI platform environments across development, test, UAT, and production.
• Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform and Bicep.
• Optimize infrastructure performance, costs, resilience, and availability.

MLOps & Deployment Automation

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI and machine learning solutions.
• Automate model deployment, validation, testing, and rollback processes.
• Support model lifecycle management, versioning, monitoring, and governance.
• Enable automated retraining and deployment workflows where required.

Cloud & Security

• Implement security best practices across AI environments.
• Manage identities, secrets, certificates, and access controls.
• Ensure compliance with organizational security and governance standards.
• Conduct vulnerability remediation and platform hardening activities.

Platform Reliability & Operations

• Establish monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability frameworks.
• Troubleshoot production incidents and perform root-cause analysis.
• Define and monitor platform SLAs, SLOs, and operational metrics.
• Drive continuous improvement of platform stability and performance.

Collaboration & Engineering Excellence

• Partner with AI Engineers and Solution Architects to operationalize AI solutions.
• Support production releases and deployment readiness reviews.
• Contribute to platform standards, reusable templates, and automation frameworks.
• Mentor development teams on DevOps and AI operational best practices.

AI / MLOps Experience

Experience in one or more of the following:

• Azure AI Foundry
• Azure OpenAI Service
• Machine Learning Operations (MLOps)
• Model deployment and monitoring
• Vector databases and retrieval systems
• LLM application deployment and operations
• AI governance and operational monitoring

Security & Governance

• Identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID.
• Secrets management using Azure Key Vault.
• Security scanning and vulnerability management.
• Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured through:

• Reliability and availability of AI platforms.
• Deployment frequency and release quality.
• Infrastructure automation coverage.
• Security and compliance adherence.
• Reduction of operational incidents and recovery times.
• Continuous improvement of AI delivery efficiency.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to build enterprise-scale AI solutions.
• Exposure to the latest Generative AI technologies.
• Collaborative and innovation-driven engineering culture.
• Career growth within a global technology organization.
• The chance to help shape the future of AI-powered enterprise software.

Qualifications
Required Skills & Experience

• 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or a similar role.
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related technical field. Masters will be an added advantage
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
• Strong experience with:

• Azure DevOps
• Bitbucket
• Terraform and/or Bicep
• Docker
• Kubernetes (AKS preferred)
• CI/CD pipeline implementation

• Experience with monitoring tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Grafana, or Prometheus.
• Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Python, or Bash.

Additional Information
We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

Analyze quality performance data, identify risks, investigate issues, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

Monitor compliance with internal quality management systems, policies, and procedures.

- Quality Control & Monitoring
Develop and implement quality control plans and inspection processes.

Review inspection and test results to ensure conformity to specifications.
Escalate quality concerns and support resolution activities.

- Non-Conformance Management
Investigate product, process, or service non-conformities.
Perform root cause analysis using quality tools such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagram, and Pareto Analysis.
Lead corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities.
Verify effectiveness of implemented corrective actions.

- Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities for process improvement and waste reduction.
Support Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, or other quality improvement programs.
Drive initiatives to improve quality performance indicators.
Facilitate lessons learned and best-practice sharing across teams. - Data Analysis & Reporting

Support investigations and corrective actions related to customer issues.
Participate in customer meetings and quality reviews where required.

Collaborate with suppliers to resolve quality issues.

ABOUT THE ROLE


Role Purpose

The Senior Product Quality Engineer holds product approval authority for supplier-manufactured parts across Powertech propulsion programs, including turbofan, microjet and piston engines.

The role reviews and approves supplier advanced product quality planning, production part approval and first article inspection submissions, defines inspection and acceptance requirements, and coordinates configuration and change management between Design Engineering, Supply Chain and suppliers.

The Senior Product Quality Engineer works closely with Industrialization & Supplier Development, Metrology & Inspection Engineering, Design Engineering, Supply Chain, Assembly and supplier quality teams, and provides technical leadership to junior Product Quality Engineers.

RESPONSIBILITIES


Product Approval & Gate Authority

• Review and approve supplier APQP submissions including process flow diagrams, PFMEA, control plans and measurement systems analysis, in line with AS9145.

• Review and approve production part approval (PPAP) packages against the agreed submission level, and issue written approval prior to serial delivery.

• Review and approve first article inspection reports in accordance with AS9102, including ballooned drawings, characteristic accountability and actual measured results.

• Determine full or partial FAI requirements arising from design, process, material, tooling, location or sub-tier changes, and from production lapses.

• Hold approval gates closed where evidence is insufficient, and articulate the technical basis for the decision to program and commercial stakeholders.

• Review supplier quality requirement compliance and assess supplier submissions against contracted obligations.

Inspection Planning & Acceptance Definition

• Define inspection and acceptance requirements for supplier-manufactured parts, including sampling strategy, inspection method and acceptance criteria.

• Develop and issue incoming inspection plans to Assembly, and support validation of inspection methods and gauging.

• Define key characteristics with Design Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering, and ensure they are correctly flowed to suppliers and reflected in control plans.

• Review measurement systems analysis and gauge capability evidence supporting product acceptance.

• Assess supplier process capability evidence against Cpk requirements on designated key characteristics.

Nonconformance, Material Review & Concession

• Create and administer material review records during new product introduction, and coordinate disposition with Design Engineering as design authority.

• Review supplier concession and deviation requests, assess technical justification and containment, and coordinate approval.

• Review supplier 8D submissions and verify effectiveness of corrective actions, including read-across to similar parts and processes.

• Support Supply Chain on serial-phase nonconformance matters requiring product approval or configuration expertise.

Configuration & Change Management

• Coordinate design change implementation with Design Engineering, Supply Chain and suppliers, ensuring changes reach suppliers only through released, revision-controlled drawings and formal change notices.

• Assess change classification and determine resulting FAI, PPAP and inspection plan impacts.

• Verify supplier acknowledgement of change notices, implementation dates and serial or batch cut-in points.

• Maintain product approval status records and configuration traceability for assigned part numbers.

Supplier Quality Engagement

• Participate in supplier gate reviews and industrialization reviews as the product approval authority.

• Conduct on-site product audits and source inspection where required, including verification of inspection practice and records.

• Support supplier readiness for product approval submissions without assuming responsibility for their preparation.

Technical Leadership

• Act as technical authority for product approval and acceptance within the team.

• Mentor Product Quality Engineer I and II staff and support their development.

• Develop and standardize product approval procedures, review checklists and acceptance criteria.

• Report product approval status, submission quality trends and escape data to management.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Manufacturing, Materials or Metrology Engineering.

• 6+ years of experience in aerospace quality, supplier quality, product quality or manufacturing engineering.

• Demonstrated authority-level experience reviewing and approving APQP, PPAP (AS9145) and first article inspection (AS9102) packages.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Strong GD&T application, tolerance interpretation and drawing analysis capability.

• Practical metrology competence — CMM, optical and contact measurement, gauge design principles, measurement systems analysis.

• Working knowledge of statistical process control and process capability assessment.

• Experience of nonconformance and material review processes, concession management and structured problem solving (8D).

• Sound understanding of manufacturing processes for machined, sheet metal fabricated and cast aerospace components, sufficient to assess submissions critically.

• Working knowledge of AS9100 and aerospace special process requirements.

• Experience of configuration and change management in a regulated engineering environment.

• Demonstrated ability to hold approval decisions under schedule and commercial pressure while maintaining constructive supplier relationships.

• Willingness to travel to supplier sites.

Overview:


Abu Dhabi

Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception42 functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Inception is seeking a highly proficient and accomplished Applied Scientist, with a proven track record, to develop efficient deep-learning and generative AI algorithms and conceive innovative AI-centric models. This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with our product development teams, applying emerging technologies across a diverse range of applications

Responsibilities:


What You’ll Own

In the Applied Scientist role you will play a crucial part in pioneering research and development across various facets of AI, including but not limited to computer vision, natural language processing, and audio signal processing. • Propose scenarios where AI techniques could improve the efficiency of the customer’s business.

• Provide pre-sales and post-sales technical support to the business development team.

Qualifications:


What We’re Looking For

The criteria for your success would include cost savings achieved, number of use cases investigated & datasets mined, number of innovations/POCs deployed, number of existing processes optimized, and customer NPS.

To qualify, you must have

• M.Sc. or Ph.D. degree in computer science, engineering, or AI-related field. Specialization in Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing or Speech and Audio are highly desirable.

• Minimum 6 years of experience in developing AI algorithms for various modalities

Ideally, you’ll also need

• A highly curious and inquisitive approach to problem-solving

• In-depth knowledge of the latest developments in AI and machine learning

• Excellent communication skills

Why Inception42

Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives.

If you want to work close to both advanced AI capability and real-world execution, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.title: 3rd Party Developer Hub Manager

Shape the future of our distribution hub with your expertise in project governance and stakeholder management.
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE:

Lead third-party development within ADNOC Distribution’s Mobility Hub strategy by originating, structuring, and coordinating investor/developer projects from concept to handover. Act as the single point of contact for external developers and investors, managing the commercial, technical, contractual, and governance requirements needed to integrate sites seamlessly into the Hub ecosystem. Ensure timely approvals, risk-controlled delivery, and operational readiness that strengthen customer experience and portfolio returns.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Job Specific Accountabilities

Partnership Origination & Commercial Structuring

• Identify and qualify 3P development opportunities aligned to hub typologies, network priorities, and investment criteria.
• Prepare and refine commercial models, heads of terms, and term-sheet options to balance value creation, risk allocation, and compliance.
• Coordinate internal inputs (Finance, Legal, BD) to validate business cases, sensitivity scenarios, and approval requirements.
• Support investor due diligence (technical, commercial, regulatory), addressing queries and aligning key assumptions.
• Draft and socialize decision packs for governance forums, ensuring clear options, risks, and recommendations.

Contract Lifecycle & Risk Management

• Lead the end-to-end contract process—from RFI/RFP support and bid clarifications to negotiation of definitive agreements.
• Ensure clarity on roles, deliverables, milestones, warranties, performance securities, and exit/step-in provisions.
• Track contractual obligations and conditions precedent (CPs), coordinating timely closure with internal and external parties.
• Maintain a live risk register covering commercial, schedule, technical, HSE, and authority risks, with mitigation plans.
• Manage variations and change control, preserving scope, economics, and governance integrity.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Technical Alignment

• Align site layout, access, utilities, and design standards with Engineering Projects, Operations, HSE, and Property Services.
• Coordinate authority requirements (utility providers, municipality, civil defense, etc.) to de-risk approvals on the critical path.
• Ensure 3P specifications support hub customer experience (wayfinding, parking circulation, tenant adjacencies, brand touchpoints).
• Validate readiness criteria for construction start (permits, insurances, method statements, interfaces).
• Facilitate technical reviews and close-out of comments to keep design and procurement on schedule.

Delivery Governance & Operational Readiness

• Run a stage-based governance cadence (business case, design freeze, pre-award, start-up, pre-opening) with documented gate criteria.
• Track execution milestones, critical path, and dependencies; escalate slippage early and propose recovery actions.
• Coordinate with Operations and HSE on commissioning, OR checklists, training/handovers, and defects management.
• Validate as-built documentation, warranties, and O&M manuals prior to handover into steady-state operations.
• Capture lessons learned and feed improvements into playbooks and templates.

Stakeholder Communication & Reporting

• Serve as the single point of contact for developers/investors, providing clear updates, action logs, and decisions required.
• Prepare concise progress reports, dashboards, and risk summaries for EMT/ELT and relevant committees.
• Coordinate with Marketing/Brand on key milestones and external communications where applicable.
• Ensure records are audit-ready (approvals, contracts, CP closures, change logs, correspondence).
• Maintain confidentiality and adherence to governance, delegation of authority (DoA), and information security standards.

Portfolio Performance & Optimization

• Monitor post-launch performance (throughput, uptime, commercial KPIs) and identify improvement opportunities with partners.
• Recommend re-scoping or enhancement measures (amenity mix, access improvements, utilities optimization) to maximize returns.
• Track contractual performance measures (SLAs, liquidated damages where applicable) and manage under-performance remedies.
• Support periodic portfolio reviews and rebalancing of pipeline priorities based on performance and market dynamics.
• Contribute to strategy refreshes, investment theses, and international roll-out playbooks as required.

Continuous Improvement & Tools

• Maintain and enhance standard templates (term sheets, risk registers, gate checklists, CP trackers, and reporting packs).
• Promote use of digital tools for document control, schedule tracking, and stakeholder collaboration.
• Benchmark external practices to refine commercial structures and execution standards.
• Propose process simplifications that reduce cycle time without compromising assurance.
• Support training and knowledge-sharing sessions across the Franchise & Property Services Division.

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

Minimum Qualification

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Management, Real Estate, or a related field.

Minimum Experience & Knowledge & Skills

• 8 years of relevant experience in commercial real‑estate development, PPP/3P projects, or mobility/retail infrastructure.
• Hands‑on experience in commercial modelling, contract negotiation, and approvals (CPs, permits, utilities).
• Strong exposure to design coordination and delivery governance (stage‑gates, risk, change control).
• Proven ability to work cross‑functionally and manage multiple stakeholders and counterparties to deadlines.
• Commercial acumen (term sheets, risk allocation, value drivers)
• Contracting & negotiation; change/claims awareness
• Technical literacy (layouts, utilities, basic MEP/HSE considerations)
• Project governance, planning, and risk management
• Executive‑level communication, presentation, and stakeholder influence
• Strong documentation, decision‑pack preparation, and audit‑readiness
• Proficiency with MS Office and project/collaboration tools (e.g., MS Project, SharePoint/Teams, Asana/Jira)

jobs.title: Data Center Infra Engineer  - 2027 Internship
jobs.summary: Ever wanted to help design and support the data centers that power the world's largest cloud? As a DC Infra Engineer Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will work alongside an experienced, cross-disciplinary
jobs.description:
Ever wanted to help design and support the data centers that power the world's largest cloud? As a DC Infra Engineer Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will work alongside an experienced, cross-disciplinary team to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers — from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. Your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

Each day, you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will help prioritize activities that support data center capacity, availability, and safety, focusing on the actions that are most impactful — and you will have the opportunity to work on projects both locally and globally. If this sounds exciting to you, come build the future with us!

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time engineering position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's or Master's degree) in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline, who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

About the Role

As an intern, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers, from design through operation. With guidance from experienced engineers, you will build your subject matter expertise and serve as an engineering resource for your region, applying what you learn to real technical challenges.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

- Perform design and equipment submittal reviews for new data centers in your region

- Troubleshoot issues, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site and equipment failures

- Support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews (including for critical equipment), and event support

- Collaborate with the internal data center design engineering team, server hardware team, and environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered

- Work on concurrent projects, sometimes across multiple geographical regions

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks, starting 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday to Thursday.

Please note that full-time engineering roles may operate on a rotating shift pattern, which could include days, evenings, weekends, and public holidays, as well as on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help design, troubleshoot, and support the infrastructure that keeps AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you help support power it all.

Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

A day in the life

0

About the team

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications
- In the last year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or another equivalent technical discipline, graduating in 2027 – before the internship´s end date

- Knowledge of Power Systems, Fluid Dynamics, and/or Thermodynamics

- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal

- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills

Preferred qualifications
- Knowledge of Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems

- Coursework in commercial or industrial power systems and/or mechanical systems

- Experience using a variety of web-based and other software tools for calculation and data processing

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and customer facing experience. We are seeking Solutions Architects that will have an opportunity to work with customers, account managers and several internal teams to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems and help accelerate the adoption of AWS. In collaboration with sales, you will drive AWS platform adoption across a broad set of customers. 



As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS within organizations ranging from new start-ups to large enterprise customers. The ability to link technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.



For the Solutions Architect role, we are looking for a candidate who is comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. He or she will be broadly competent across many areas of technology and deep in a handful of areas. It's ok for them to be less deep in some places, but we need to feel confident that they have the fundamentals and the ability to learn complex new technologies quickly. 



On the business side, we are looking for excellent communication skills. The Solutions Architect will spend most of their day interacting with customers via email, phone, instant messaging, and in-person meetings. They will meet with developers, team leads, engineering directors, and CxOs. Given the large portion of customers who are self-served, interest in and ability to create one-to-many content such as reference architectures and blog posts is an important part of the role.



On the soft-skills side, we are looking for ability to moderate tone and technical depth based on audience and solid ability to pick up on non-verbal communication. Also ability to pick up on “un-said” drivers is important.



On the personal attributes side, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about technology and have the drive and capability to absorb and retain vast amounts of deep technical information continuously.





Job responsibilities

• As a key member of the business development and sales team, ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform

• Partner with the account management team, formulate and execute an account strategy.

• Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud

• Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS

• Capture and share best-practice knowledge within the AWS solutions architect community

• Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers

• Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates

• Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

Basic qualifications
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications
- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

jobs.description:
We are hiring a Solutions Architect to work with Enterprise and Strategic customers in central Saudi Arabia, based in Riyadh. Saudi Arabia is one of the fastest-growing cloud markets in the Middle East, fuelled by Vision 2030 and ambitious national digital transformation programmes across government, healthcare, aviation, retail, and financial services. This role is central to AWS's growth strategy in the Kingdom — you will serve as a key technical advisor for a portfolio of enterprise customers, helping them modernise legacy platforms, adopt AI and cloud-native architectures, and accelerate their digital agendas.

Solutions Architects engage with customers to understand their business drivers, assess application portfolios, and design reliable, cost-effective cloud-native architectures. As a Solutions Architect, you will partner with Account Managers, Business Development representatives, Professional Services, Specialist SAs, and AWS Service Teams to create solutions that address business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. You will also contribute to competitive displacement engagements, helping customers migrate workloads to AWS.

You should enjoy thinking strategically about business, products, and technical challenges. We are looking for candidates who are comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. The Solutions Architect is a technical role — you must be broadly competent across many areas of technology (Generative AI, Agentic AI, cloud infrastructure, security, DevOps, databases, application development, data analytics) and developing depth in at least 1–2 of those areas. On the business side, the ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical for our customers' successful use of AWS. You will spend most of your day interacting with multiple customer stakeholders, including Directors, Architects, Developers, and Engineers.

Key job responsibilities

- In partnership with Account Managers and Business Development, support long-term customer success, satisfaction, and trust through the adoption of AWS services and well-architected solutions.

- Serve as a technical advisor for enterprise customers in the Riyadh and central Saudi Arabia region, building relationships with customer stakeholders and contributing to their technology strategy.

- Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS and participate in architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud, including competitive migration paths from other cloud providers to AWS.

- Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many enablement sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS (e.g., Dev Days, Immersion Days, Workshops, and GameDays).

- Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS Solutions Architect community; contribute to customer-facing publications such as white papers, blog posts, and reference architectures.

- Act as a technical liaison between customers, AWS Service Teams, and Support — gathering product feedback, driving feature requests, and collaborating with fellow Solutions Architects in the region.

A day in the life

As a Solutions Architect in Riyadh, your day revolves around customer impact. You might start the morning reviewing an architecture proposal for an enterprise customer exploring a migration from on-premises or competing cloud platforms to AWS. Mid-morning, you join a technical session with a customer's engineering team, working through a solution design for their application platform and advising on the right mix of compute, AI/ML, and data services.

After lunch, you collaborate with your Account Manager and the wider account team on a strategy call — contributing to the technical win plan for a competitive opportunity and identifying the right Specialist SAs or ProServe resources to bring in. Later in the afternoon, you might support a workshop or Immersion Day for a group of developers at a customer site, walking them through hands-on labs on Amazon Bedrock, GenAI application patterns, or container modernisation with EKS.

Between customer meetings, you capture feedback on product gaps, contribute to a blog post on a solution pattern, or review an architecture alongside a teammate. Your week also includes internal syncs with the broader KSA SA team, community knowledge-sharing sessions, and preparation for upcoming events. No two days are the same, but the constant is clear: you are a trusted technical partner for your customers, and your work directly drives their success on AWS.

About the team

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Basic qualifications
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications
- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Cloud Services
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Engineer - Cloud Services

The Big Picture  

About Sysco LABS: 

Sysco LABS is the Global In-House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world’s largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 55th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry. 

Sysco operates 333 distribution centers across 10 countries, with 75,000 colleagues serving approximately 670,000 customer locations, including restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, lodging establishments, entertainment venues and more. For fiscal year 2026, which ended June 27, 2026, the company generated sales of more than $84 billion. 

Sysco LABS Sri Lanka delivers the technology that powers Sysco’s end-to-end operations. 

Sysco LABS’ enterprise technology is present in the end-to-end foodservice journey, enabling the sourcing of food products, merchandising, storage and warehouse operations, order placement and pricing algorithms, the delivery of food and supplies to Sysco’s global network and the in-restaurant dining experience of the end-customer. 

Role Overview

As a Senior Engineer of Sysco’s Global Public Cloud Engineering Team, you will own and support our multi-cloud, hybrid infrastructure and service transformation. You will assist the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and highly available cloud environments across AWS, GCP, and Azure, Fastly (CDN/WAF) and Cloud Governance Platforms focusing relentlessly on cloud-native patterns and the lowest total cost of ownership (TCO). Blending hands-on engineering execution with technical leadership, you will set enterprise standards for Infrastructure-as-Code, automated governance, edge security, and developer enablement.

Key Responsibilities

1. Architecture & Cloud Transformation

• Act as point of contact for multi-cloud, hybrid infrastructure services transformation, establishing architecture standards and golden patterns for provisioning and deployment.

• Support cloud-native solutions over legacy lift-and-shift patterns, aligning all designs with the six pillars of the Well-Architected Framework (Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, and Sustainability).

• Design and implement enterprise cloud architectures, develop cloud landing zones and platform capabilities, design hybrid-cloud and multi-cloud connectivity.

• Define and own end-to-end Solution Architecture (Infrastructure, applications, and data technologies) utilizing service-oriented architecture principles.

• Assist migration initiatives, including On-Premises-to-Cloud and Cloud-to-Cloud migrations with zero downtime architectures and robust Disaster Recovery (DR) validation.

• AI Infrastructure & Workload Support: Support robust, scalable, and secure underlying cloud infrastructure for AI/ML workloads (including GPU-optimized nodes, vector database connectivity, and secure model serving endpoints) across AWS, GCP, and Azure.

• AI-Assisted Engineering Productivity: Help the secure adoption of AI-driven developer tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q) within infrastructure teams, establishing safety guardrails for automated code and Infrastructure-as-Code generation.

• ITIL-Aligned Cloud Engineering/Operations: Bridge modern cloud engineering practices with IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks (ITIL v4 or above), ensuring rapid deployment velocity is balanced with robust service quality, predictability, and risk control.

2. Governance, Security & Compliance

• Design and enforce enterprise Cloud Governance strategies, implementing automated guardrails and continuous compliance using Cloud Custodian and native cloud policies (e.g., AWS SCPs, Azure Policies).

• Support comprehensive Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM), tenant isolation, federated authentication, and least-privilege security models.

• Partner with security teams to configure and manage enterprise edge security architectures, integrating Fastly CDN and NFWAF (Next-Gen WAF) to protect core applications from modern web threats.

• Ensure end-to-end security and regulatory compliance across all enterprise infrastructure, data pipelines, and application configurations.

• AI Governance & Policy-as-Code: Extend Cloud Custodian and native cloud governance engines to audit, monitor, and enforce compliance policies on cloud-hosted AI and generative AI services, preventing unauthorized shadow AI deployments.

• AI Security & Data Privacy: Partner with security teams to ensure secure data pipelines, strict API rate-limiting, and egress/ingress protection via Fastly CDN and NFWAF for enterprise AI applications. Implement FinOps guardrails specifically tailored for high-cost AI/ML resource consumption.

3. DevOps, Automation & CI/CD Excellence

• Standardize and govern Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform and Terragrunt for modular, DRY multi-cloud deployments.

• Optimization and management of CI/CD pipelines, driving adoption toward GitHub and GitHub Actions while managing legacy Jenkins maintenance.

• Develop advanced automation scripts and custom orchestration tools using Python, Bash, and PowerShell.

• Ability to support configuration management frameworks and server baseline standards using Ansible, alongside containerized runtime workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.

4. Technical Leadership & Engineering Support

• Troubleshoot critical production issues, perform root cause analyses, and drive technical problem-solving across cross-functional engineering squads.

• Conducting rigorous code and Pull Request (PR) reviews for Terraform configurations and CI/CD pipelines.

• Build and maintain comprehensive internal knowledge bases, technical documentation, and reusable architecture decision records (ADRs).

• Articulate technical risks, cost-capacity ratios, and strategic roadmaps clearly to audiences ranging from operations engineers to executive stakeholders.

• Internal Platform Development – In-house cloud platform management solutions development - Develop self-service platform capabilities etc.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent.

• 4+ years of total progressive industry experience in IT infrastructure and software delivery.

• 2+ years of dedicated hands-on cloud engineering, platform design, or operational experience.

• Proven track record of hands-on experience across at least one major cloud vendor (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP). Experience in two cloud vendors would be an advantage.

Technical Competencies

• Thorough understanding or core cloud foundational services (networking/VPC peering, enterprise IAM, hybrid connectivity, compute, and container runtimes) across AWS, GCP, and Azure, with a proven ability to design and manage resilient, high-performance multi-cloud platforms.

• Expertise in Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Terragrunt) and modern CI/CD ecosystems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

• Strong working knowledge of configuration management and automation frameworks (Python, Bash, PowerShell, Ansible).

• Understanding of networking, CDN caching tiers, WAF configurations (i.e. Fastly CDN, NGWAF), and hybrid cloud connectivity.

• Experience in implementing/supporting cloud security controls, encryption (at rest and in transit), key management systems, vulnerability assessments, and SIEM integrations.

• AI Governance & Cloud Integration: Familiarity with supporting governance, security controls, and resource optimization for cloud-native AI/ML services.

• Responsible AI & Compliance: Understanding of data residency, privacy frameworks, and security baselines required when deploying AI models in enterprise multi-cloud environments.

• ITSM & ITIL Frameworks: Solid working knowledge of ITIL principles, particularly concerning change enablement, incident management, problem management, and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) tracking in multi-cloud architectures.

Certifications & Soft Skills

• Cloud Certifications: Active certification from at least one major cloud provider at the minimum of Associate/Engineer level.

• Infrastructure Automation Certifications: Having HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (or higher Authoring and Operations Professional) is an added advantage.

• Service Management: Certification in ITIL v4 Foundation or above would be an added advantage.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation abilities; adept at translating complex architectural trade-offs and risks into business terms for executive leadership.

Benefits:  

• Performance-based annual bonus  

• Performance rewards and recognition  

• Agile Benefits - special allowances for Health, Wellness & Academic purposes  

• Entertainment allowance  

• Team engagement allowance  

• Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Cover - extendable to parents and in-laws  

• Hybrid work arrangement  

  

Sysco LABS is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: AVP, Trade Support - Dealer Assist & Data Readiness
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION

The role supports the VP & Head of GM MO Trade Support by managing day-to-day Dealer Assist and Data Readiness activities across Global Markets products, ensuring Front Office Sales and Trading desks receive timely, accurate and consistent operational support. The role coordinates client ready-to-trade activities, product activation readiness, counterparty setup, account and portfolio readiness, static/reference data dependencies, SSI enrichment requirements and new product operational readiness from a Trade Support perspective. The role manages T0 Dealer Assist requests, trade booking support queries, allocation support, enrichment follow-up, affirmation/confirmation monitoring support and settlement-readiness dependencies, ensuring timely escalation and hand-off to relevant owner functions. The role works closely with Front Office, GM MO Trade Support, Operations, KYC, Credit, Compliance, GM Documentation, Reference Data, Technology, Product Control, Market Risk and regional teams to remove blockers, improve service quality and support scalable trade execution support.The role does not own independent Control & Governance responsibilities such as trading permissions controls, booking template controls, off-market monitoring, counterparty exposure monitoring, reconciliations, collateral management, regulatory reporting, RCSA/KRI ownership or control effectiveness testing.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Dealer Assist Operating Discipline
• Execute and coordinate daily Dealer Assist activities in line with approved service standards, request channels, escalation protocols and handover routines.
• Manage Front Office request intake, triage, prioritisation, allocation and follow-up across assigned products, desks or regional coverage points.
• Support trade booking queries, client account allocations, portfolio allocations, sales-support requests and trade-flow coordination required by Sales and Trading desks.
• Maintain request logs, workload trackers, escalation records and service commentary to support transparent service management.
Identify recurring Dealer Assist issues, process gaps and capacity constraints, and escalate improvement opportunities to the VP & Head of GM MO Trade Support.
• Client Activation and Ready-to-Trade Coordination
• Coordinate client onboarding and ready-to-trade activities with KYC, Credit, Compliance, GM Documentation, Reference Data, Operations and Front Office teams.
• Track client, counterparty, product, account, portfolio, SSI, static data and reference-data dependencies required for trading enablement.
Support product activation and counterparty activation by coordinating required data, documentation, system setup and stakeholder actions.
Escalate onboarding blockers, incomplete setup items, documentation gaps and system-readiness issues impacting Front Office execution.
Maintain readiness trackers and provide timely updates on open actions, owners, deadlines and risks to trade readiness.
• Data Readiness and Static / Reference Data Coordination
• Support static data, reference data, market data and SSI readiness activities required for accurate trade booking, enrichment, validation and downstream processing.
• Coordinate with Reference Data, Technology, Operations, Market Risk and relevant owner functions to resolve data-quality or setup issues impacting trade support.
• Perform completeness checks on operational data dependencies and ensure items are appropriately routed, tracked and escalated.
Support new product operational readiness by coordinating data, system and workflow dependencies from a Trade Support perspective.
Identify recurring data-readiness issues and support root-cause analysis, remediation actions and process standardisation.
T0 Trade Support and Enrichment Support
• Support T0 trade support activities including non-economic booking support, enrichment follow-up, allocation support and trade-flow coordination.
Coordinate with T0 Validation teams to ensure required trade-support information is complete and available for validation, affirmation, confirmation and settlement-readiness processes.
• Support Front Office queries relating to booking support, account/portfolio mapping, SSI enrichment, missing data and trade-support dependencies.
Escalate aged, urgent or high-impact trade support items to the VP & Head of GM MO Trade Support and relevant owner functions.
Ensure unresolved control, reconciliation, collateral, regulatory or risk-monitoring matters are handed off to GM MO Control & Governance or other owner functions as appropriate.
• Affirmation, Confirmation and Settlement-Readiness Support
• Monitor assigned affirmation and confirmation support items, coordinating follow-up with relevant teams where trade-support information is required.
Support settlement-readiness by ensuring account setup, allocation, SSI, enrichment and required non-economic data dependencies are complete or escalated.
• Coordinate with Operations, Trade Support, Product Control, Front Office and regional teams to resolve trade-support dependencies that may impact timely downstream processing.
• Track open support items, commentary, owner actions and escalation status to support daily service discipline.
Contribute to reduction of recurring trade-support issues by identifying upstream data, booking or workflow causes.
Stakeholder Management and Service Delivery
• Act as a day-to-day Trade Support contact for Front Office Sales and Trading desks on Dealer Assist and data-readiness matters.
Coordinate across KYC, Credit, Compliance, GM Documentation, Reference Data, Technology, Operations, Product Control and regional teams to remove trade-support blockers.
• Maintain clear communication on service status, pending actions, escalation requirements and expected next steps.
Support effective hand-offs between Dealer Assist, T0 Validation, Operations and GM MO Control & Governance functions.
Promote a service-oriented culture focused on responsiveness, accuracy, ownership, clear escalation and Front Office enablement.
Reporting, MI and Service Inputs
• Prepare inputs for Trade Support service reporting, operational dashboards, request volumes, SLA adherence, backlog ageing and recurring issue themes.
• Provide accurate commentary on client readiness, data-readiness blockers, Dealer Assist activity and trade-support escalation items.
• Maintain request and readiness trackers to support management visibility and service performance analysis.
• Contribute to KPI and service-quality inputs required by the VP & Head of GM MO Trade Support.
• Support standardized MI and dashboard enhancements for Trade Support and Data Readiness activities.
• Process Improvement, Automation and UAT
• Identify opportunities to simplify request management, reduce manual hand-offs, improve data-readiness tracking and enhance service visibility.
• Participate in UAT, workflow design, dashboard development and automation initiatives impacting Dealer Assist and Data Readiness processes.
• Support standardization of templates, request categories, escalation formats, handover processes and operating procedures.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance STP, service quality, capacity and operational scalability.
• Support knowledge transfer and cross-training across Dealer Assist, Data Readiness and T0 Validation teams.
• People, Capability and Coverage Support
• Coach Specialists were assigned and support day-to-day task allocation, workload balancing and service discipline within the Dealer Assist & Data Readiness team.
• Support cross-product capability building across FX/MM, Derivatives, Commodities, Capital Markets and other applicable products.
Assist in documenting procedures, process maps, checklists and training materials for Trade Support activities.
• Promote accountability, ownership, timely escalation and consistent service standards across the team.
•
Support succession planning, coverage resilience and cross-training initiatives led by the VP & Head of GM MO Trade Support.

Key Working Relationships

• Internal stakeholders include the VP & Head of GM MO Trade Support, Head of Global Markets Middle Office, GM MO Control & Governance, Front Office
• Sales and Trading desks, Global Markets Operations, Product Control, Market Risk, Finance, Compliance, Legal, Technology, Credit, KYC, GM Documentation, Reference Data and regional Middle Office teams.
•
External stakeholders may include clients, counterparties, custodians, brokers, clearing channels or market infrastructure providers where Dealer Assist or Data Readiness coordination is required to support client readiness, trade readiness, affirmation, confirmation or settlement-readiness activities.

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting or a related discipline; professional qualification preferred.
• 7+ years of experience in Global Markets Operations, Middle Office, Trade Support, Dealer Assist, Client Onboarding, Reference Data, Front Office support or related operational support functions.
• Strong understanding of Global Markets products including FX, Money Markets, Rates, Derivatives, Commodities, Capital Markets and structured products.
• Good knowledge of trade lifecycle processes including client readiness, product activation, counterparty setup, trade booking support, enrichment, validation, affirmation, confirmation and settlement-readiness support.
• Experience coordinating with Front Office, KYC, Credit, Compliance, GM Documentation, Reference Data, Technology, Operations, Product Control and regional teams.
• Practical knowledge of systems and platforms such as Murex, Bloomberg, MarkitWire / matching platforms, reference-data tools, workflow trackers and dashboard tools.
• Strong stakeholder management, prioritisation, communication, escalation, documentation and service-delivery skills.
•
Experience supporting process standardization, automation, UAT, operating-model change or service improvement.

Preferred / Beneficial

• Professional qualification preferred.
• Skills
• Global Markets Trade Support
• Dealer Assist operating model
• Client activation and ready-to-trade processes
• Product and counterparty activation
• Static, SSI and reference data coordination
• Market data readiness coordination
• Trade booking support and allocations
• Account and portfolio mapping support
• Trade enrichment support
• Same-Day Validation support inputs
• Affirmation and confirmation monitoring support
• Settlement-readiness dependencies
• FX/MM, Rates, Derivatives and Commodities lifecycle
• Murex, Markit Wire and Bloomberg knowledge
• Queue management and SLA tracking
• Handover discipline and request management
• Process improvement and STP mindset
• UAT, workflow automation and dashboard requirements
• Cross-functional stakeholder management
• Service performance reporting
• Service excellence
• Front Office partnership
• Execution discipline
• Attention to detail
• Clear communication
• Stakeholder management
• Accountability and ownership
• Prioritizations under pressure
• Issue-resolution focus
• Collaboration across function
• Ability to manage multiple requests
• Coaching and knowledge sharing
• Ability to work across products, regions and teams.

Develop and maintain Ground Control Station (GCS) software using the Qt Framework and QML, with a focus on intuitive and high-performance GUI development. Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including planning, design, coding, testing, integration, and deployment. Collaborate with hardware and embedded systems teams to ensure seamless integration of software with connected and networked components. Perform integration testing to validate system functionality, reliability, and performance.

Document software architecture, design decisions, and requirement specifications, ensuring clarity and traceability. Create and maintain user guides and technical documentation to support end users and internal teams. Write and maintain unit tests to ensure high-quality, reliable, and maintainable software. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Computer) or Computer Science. Minimum 10 years of software development experience (or 7+ years with a Master’s degree). At least 5 years of hands-on experience in C++ development. Strong expertise in Qt Framework, Qt QML, and GUI-based application development. Proven experience working with large and complex codebases.

Strong proficiency in C++ and object-oriented programming principles, along with solid understanding of design patterns. Deep expertise in Qt Framework, Qt QML, and GUI development. Experience in integration and unit testing, especially in embedded systems environments. Good understanding of networking protocols such as TCP, UDP, and IP.

Hands-on experience with Linux-based development environments and familiarity with Python for supporting tools and automation. Experience with continuous integration tools such as Jenkins. Understanding of real-time operating systems (RTOS) and real-time software design concepts. Familiarity with communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, and Ethernet.

Awareness of safety-critical software standards such as DO-178C, ISO 26262, and RTCA guidelines. Experience handling large or legacy codebases, including refactoring and integration. Strong debugging, performance optimization, and testing skills. Knowledge of version control systems such as Git. Familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies is an added advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer: Software  (Embedded Software)
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


We are seeking an experienced Senior Embedded Software Engineer for Halcon to design, develop, test, and verify safety-critical real-time embedded software for advanced defence and aerospace systems. The successful candidate will contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements decomposition and architecture design to integration, verification, and technical leadership.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Design, develop, and maintain embedded software solutions using C/C++ for real-time and safety-critical applications.

• Derive low-level software requirements, architecture, and design from higher-level system and software specifications.

• Perform software integration, verification, debugging, and validation activities, including SIL, HIL, and hardware-software integration testing.

• Participate in technical reviews, prepare engineering documentation, and mentor junior engineers on software development best practices.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 8 years of experience in embedded software development with strong proficiency in C/C++.

• Hands-on experience with RTOS and/or bare-metal embedded systems, device drivers, and low-level hardware interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet).

• Experience with software verification, debugging tools, version control systems (Git/SVN), and requirements management tools such as DOORS or JAMA.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Experience in defence, aerospace, aviation, missile systems, UAVs, or other safety-critical environments.

• Knowledge of MISRA C/C++ standards and familiarity with DO-178C software development and certification processes.

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

CANDIDATE PRIVACY & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. We believe every individual deserves to be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, and our employment decisions reflect that. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

Please note that EDGE does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes in the absence of a formally executed agreement in place will be deemed the property of EDGE, and no placement fees or compensation will be payable in respect of such submissions.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Product Designer to shape the user experience of botim, an AI-native fintech platform serving millions of users across payments, financial services, communications, and platform capabilities.

You will design complex, high-impact fintech experiences where trust, speed, and scalability matter. Requirements

Preferred

• Experience with super-apps or platform products.

jobs.description:
Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

About the Role

As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:

- Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear

- Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)

- Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers

- Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)

- Building automation systems

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment

- Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures

- Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

- Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment

- Using internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.

Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will troubleshoot and maintain the systems that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you maintain power it all.

Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications
- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, graduating in 2027 - before the end of the internship.

- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal

- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills

Preferred qualifications
- Experience in program or project management

- Knowledge of mechanical systems (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning systems, controls)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
